svg.title: Website account handover to DorkOS Cloud
svg.desc: Without a valid configured accounts origin the website serves local accounts. When configured, selected browser routes redirect and machine calls proxy to the accounts origin. Managed connections are a separate migration. This diagram describes code behavior, not the production switch state.
